notes: Rejuvenation is a WSI-family (Williams-Sonoma Inc) brand, same platform as Pottery Barn/West Elm. Direct fetch and WebFetch both 403 rejuvenation.com; r.jina.ai (also used across this batch) returned a persistent Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge on every retry over ~4 minutes of spaced attempts, so the rendered 'N Items' header could not be read directly this run. curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 reaches the site (200) but the initial HTML ships with the product grid empty ('totalProductsCount':0) - the page is a client-side SPA that populates its grid entirely from Constructor.io (ac.cnstrc.com, key=key_9BhS51IOFNhJejk4, discovered via preconnect hints and apiBaseURI in page JSON), so that API is the sole product-data source available to the browser, not merely a discovery aid. Every qty below is an EXHAUSTION COUNT: paged group_id browse calls (num_results_per_page=120) counting unique product IDs until an empty page, cross-checked against the API's own total_num_results field - all listed rows matched exactly (unique-ID count == total_num_results) on the read taken. Flagged as best-available-evidence given the coordinator's standing warning that Constructor totals proved inflated vs rendered on other WSI sites (pbteen.com); no rendered-header cross-check was reachable here despite repeated tries, so treat as MANUAL REVIEW candidates if a future worker gets r.jina.ai through. Category tree discovered via Constructor's group_id hierarchy (root 'all' -> lighting/mirrors/bath/kitchen/outdoor/bedroom/decor/vintage) plus /netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-index.xml (800 URLs) for canonical slugs. Rule 0 applied throughout: traversed every lighting-by-room branch (bath, kitchen, bedroom, outdoor) and every ceiling/wall/lamp fixture-type branch; kept all room-qualified nodes even where they overlap the general type tree (documented below), consistent with Rule 0.6. DROPPED as pure rollups/'shop all' equivalents after product-ID overlap checks (>=88% containment): All Ceiling Lighting (378, covers Pendants+Chandeliers+Flush Mounts+Track+Under-Cabinet), All Wall Lighting (210, covers Wall Sconces+Picture Lights), All Lamps (91, covers Table+Floor+Task Lamps), All Mirrors (85, covers Wall+Floor Mirrors), All Outdoor Lighting & Fans (188, mixes excluded ceiling fans into the outdoor lighting rollup - kept only its 4 pure-lighting children), All Bath Lighting (155, covers Bath Wall+Ceiling Lighting), All Lighting & Fans/bedroom (51, mixes fans). DROPPED as facet/style re-cuts (not room-based, so Rule 0.6's exception does not apply): Swing Arm Sconces and Pin-Up/Plug-In Sconces (100% contained in Wall Sconces - mechanism-type facet); ~100 individual named 'X Lighting/Bath/Kitchen Collection' nodes (single product-line pages, e.g. Adeline/Carson/Eastmoreland Lighting Collection, each 1-30 items); all color facets (Black/White/Blue/Red/Green/Grey/Yellow Lighting, Shop by Color); Metal Finishes, LED Lighting, Motion Sensor Lighting (attribute facets); the entire 'Vintage' department (568 items: Pendants/Chandeliers/Sconces/Flush Mounts re-tagged by style - vintage, industrial, mid-century, art deco, classical revival, Victorian - a style re-cut of the same main Lighting/Furniture inventory, not a room); Metal Framed Mirror Collection and Bentwood Mirror Collection (named product-line subsets of Wall Mirrors). DOCUMENTED OVERLAP kept per Rule 0.6 (two genuine nav branches, not a duplicate URL): Bathroom Mirrors (87, room branch under /shop/bath/) overlaps 70-80% with the general Wall Mirrors (72, type branch under /shop/mirrors/) - both emitted since the site presents both a type tree and a room tree; Picture Lights (13) is 100% contained in Wall Sconces (210) but is Rule 0.2's explicitly-named branch and the site lists it as its own nav node, so both are kept. EXCLUDED as bathroom hardware, not mirrors (Rule 0.3 caveat): Medicine Cabinets (15 items, titles all 'Dual/Inset/Surface Mount Medicine Cabinet' - marketed as storage fixtures, not mirrors, despite 87% product-ID overlap with the Bath Mirrors listing) and Pivot Mirrors (32, 94% contained in Bath Mirrors - a shape facet of the same listing, not a distinct branch). EXCLUDED as non-decor/functional per standard rules: all Bath/Kitchen plumbing, faucets, sinks, showers, bathtubs, vanities, hardware, hooks, towel bars, storage; ceiling fans and portable fans/heaters wrongly tagged under 'lighting/portable' (Vornado fans, space heater); Light Bulbs; Accessories & Sound Machines (track hardware + a white-noise machine); house numbers/doorbells/mailboxes/gate hardware/door knockers; garden tools, VegTrug, fire pits, patio umbrellas, outdoor furniture; rugs, doormats, curtains, pillows/throws/bedding/poufs (textiles); Wreaths & Garlands and dried-floral 'Outdoor Accessories & Decor' (explicitly excluded faux/dried botanical); Wallpaper; Fireplace Tools/Screens/Log Carriers (functional hearth hardware, not in the INCLUDE list); Baskets & Storage / Decorative Baskets (storage, not in the INCLUDE list); Candles & Diffusers (29 items, dominated by the LINNEA scented candle/diffuser line with only one unscented candle-holder SKU and no separate unscented-only listing - dropped whole per the home-fragrance rule); Pet Accessories, Cleaning Supplies, Pantry Organizers, Hampers; Holiday/Sale/New Arrivals/Bestsellers/In-Stock/Custom-Made/Contract-Grade/Vault-Mount-Compatible/ADA-Accessible marketing or feature facets; 'Dining Room Decor & Accessories' (15 items, majority wallpaper/scented-candle/doorstop with only 2-3 qualifying items, dropped as a mixed roll-up rather than padded - its clean decorative children Clocks and Decorative Bowls & Trays are extracted separately). Planters: kept Indoor Planters (28) and Outdoor Planters (61) as the two clean room-based listings (genuine ceramic/terracotta/concrete pots, not faux plants); dropped 'Planters & Pots' (all-planters, 38) and Modern/Classic Planters as overlapping, non-exhaustive facet subsets of the same two room listings.
